I am 65 years old and I have worked this land for 50 years. My farm is only 1.7 mu — a small plot, but it is what I have. With just my wife and me in the household, and her working off-farm part of the time, I manage this field mostly by myself. I am too old for the rush of wheat-maize double cropping, so I plant one crop of maize in the spring and harvest it in late August. That gives me time and saves my back.

This year, like last year, I will plant denghai 605 hybrid seed. I buy one package per mu, about 50 yuan — the extension agent recommends it and my neighbor down the road gets good yield with it, so I trust it. I will not till the soil; I have been using no-tillage for my maize and it works fine. At my age, less labor is better, and the soil stays moist.

For fertilizer, I will spread 80 jin of special compound fertilizer per mu before planting. That works out to about 2.5 bags for my whole plot. The bag says it is 30-5-5, so that is enough nitrogen for the whole season. I do not topdress — one application is enough for single maize on a small plot, and fertilizer prices keep going up. I have a well for irrigation, but pumping costs electricity, so I will water three times: once after sowing if the weather is dry, once at jointing, and once when the tassels come out. I will spray insecticide three times and herbicide once, same as I have done for years. If the weather cooperates, I expect about 625 kg per mu, maybe a bit more if the rain comes at the right time.
